findings.message:
[P2] Queued group save can leave card showing stale rows

When a group save is queued behind a different successful group save, the earlier response runs `applyProjectDomains` and re-renders the waiting group from the older project snapshot. The waiting save then PATCHes values captured before waiting and its success path skips rendering that group, so the card shows the pre-save rows and `Unsaved` even though the server accepted the edit; saving that same group again can revert the accepted change. Re-sync the queued group from its response, or block all card controls until the in-flight save completes.

public/admin_projects.js:420-422

summary: The queue serializes per-card PATCH requests and fixes the name-then-group revision conflict, but a group save queued behind another group save can finish with its rows showing the older snapshot.

evidence: `beginProjectSave` keeps one pending promise per card in `projectSaveQueues`, so a second save waits for the first.
`saveProject` and `saveProjectDomains` both await `previous` before issuing their PATCH, covering the blur-triggered name save followed by a group-save click.
Both request bodies read `article.dataset.revision` after that await, so the queued group save uses the revision returned by the name save and both edits apply.
